cap_basis.call_caps: EP007 ep007-owner-authorize-shorts-narration-20260922: four scripts, one call per stage, no retries.
cap_basis.google: EP007's cap was 0.15 USD for 459 locked words. EP009's four total 534 words and each call also carries the 955 character candidate-C4 prompt, so the forecast is 0.111866 USD using EP007's own estimator. Under 0.15 that leaves only about 0.038 of headroom, enough for a longer-than-forecast guide to strand the batch after three calls. Raised to 0.20 to cover four calls with headroom, not to permit a fifth.
cap_basis.elevenlabs: EP007 capped 3200 credits for 459 words. EP009's 534 words forecast 3506 credits at 1000 per minute, so the cap is 4000.
cap_basis.retries: ElevenLabs Voice Changer is seeded, so a retry returns identical audio (finding N4B-3). Single shot, judged against the accepted guide.
cap_basis.estimator: google_cost is EP007's exact function: output seconds at 25 tokens per second and 20 USD per million, plus prompt and text characters as input tokens one to one. An estimate, never an invoice.

gates: Written intent before every provider call, receipt or error after. An unresolved intent stops the batch.
Reverse-rendering gate at prepare: undoing the declared renderings must reproduce the owner-locked written words exactly.
Guide tail energy below 0.02 (calibrate.TAIL_ENERGY_THRESHOLD) or the batch stops, no retry.
Exact-copy ASR gate per guide: hyperframes@0.8.59 whisper small.en, normalized token sequence equal to the bound spoken text.
All four guides pass both gates before any transfer is submitted.
Live balance re-read before each transfer; stop if it no longer covers the unsubmitted remainder.
failure_policy: Stop and report after any failed or uncertain provider outcome. No retry. Never transfer a guide that failed either gate.
